material_description: CB850h | N-doped zeolite-beta-templated carbon: as CB850 (template ZTB, 850 °C CVD) but the zeolite/carbon composite was heated a further 3 h under N2 flow without acetonitrile before HF removal of the template
purification_method: washed several times with 10% HF to remove the zeolite framework; dried in oven at 120 °C
source_location: SI p.4 (S4), SI Fig 3S curve d (CB850h), digitized marker
notes: archive: SI_Fig3S_d_CB850h.json; branch inferred from marker glyph (up-triangle = adsorption, down-triangle = desorption; legend glyphs are not printed in the paper); same isotherm as Fig 4 curve d recalculated without buoyancy correction for adsorbed H2 (main text p.1676-1677; SI Fig 3S caption); coded as its own isotherm because the data treatment differs; T printed as -196 °C; degas: outgassed under heating at 200 °C overnight, end pressure printed as 10^-10 bar (=1e-5 Pa), duration not numeric; BET range: P/Po 0.02-0.25 (as printed); isotherm_point_count is a lower bound (dense low-pressure markers could not be resolved)
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy: carbon density 1.5 g/cm3 from He sorption data (IGA, up to 20 bar, 323 K); no buoyancy correction for adsorbed H2

purification_method: washed several times with 10% HF to remove the zeolite framework; dried in oven at 120 °C
source_location: SI p.8 (S8), SI Fig 7S, -196 °C isotherm (CB850h), digitized marker
notes: archive: SI_Fig7S_CB850h_minus196C.json; branch inferred from marker glyph (up-triangle = adsorption, down-triangle = desorption; legend glyphs are not printed in the paper); SI Fig 7S caption does not state the measurement method, buoyancy correction or data treatment (method taken as gravimetric because the paper measured 0-20 bar by IGA); values differ from Fig 4 curve d and Fig 3S curve d so coded as a separate isotherm; 2.21 bar marker partly hidden and not extracted; T printed as -196 °C; degas: outgassed under heating at 200 °C overnight, end pressure printed as 10^-10 bar (=1e-5 Pa), duration not numeric; BET range: P/Po 0.02-0.25 (as printed); isotherm_point_count is a lower bound (dense low-pressure markers could not be resolved)
